title: Im currently working on ac2 ue5 full remake
author: Fast-Aardvark-8015
selftext:
**I’m remaking the entire Assassin’s Creed II in Unreal Engine 5 – from scratch!**  
I’ve been working on a full Unreal Engine 5 remake of **Assassin’s Creed II** for almost two months now.

**Follow the development progress(ai uploads it into my drive folder)  here:**

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E-JWw1tpcDSjoo9JbMmO\_nzm57aZF\_Ax

Unfortunately, Reddit isn’t letting me attach images to this post, so I’ve made the progress available through Google Drive. AI automatically uploads development screenshots, builds and test results there.  
Just to clarify the scope: this is intended to be a **complete remake of the entire original Assassin’s Creed II**, not an emulation project or just a recreation of a few scenes. I’m rebuilding the game in UE5, including its gameplay systems, mechanics, environments, NPCs and assets.  
**Current progress:**  
**Parkour system:** Almost completely finished. Only some polishing is left.  
**NPC system:** Currently my main focus. NPC behaviour, interactions and crowd systems are already quite advanced.  
**World and environments:** The entire map is finished, including Venice, Florence, Rome, Tuscany, the Abstergo facility and all modern-day sections.  
**Models and assets:** All models are already in place.  
**Next steps:** Combat system, followed by story implementation and mission mechanics.  
Once the full game is playable, I want to go beyond simply porting it. I plan to upgrade the original experience with modern textures, improved lighting and a more advanced parkour system, potentially borrowing mechanics from Assassin’s Creed Unity and the Kenway games. I’m also considering changing the weather system and reworking some mission designs.  
I’ve been using Claude (Max subscription) extensively throughout development. If anyone would like to support the project and help me afford a higher subscription so I can develop it faster, any contribution is greatly appreciated!

**Revolut support link:** https://revolut.me/vargadavid14

Feel free to ask questions, suggest features or share ideas in the comments. I’d love to hear your thoughts!  
**Almost two months in, and there’s still a lot to do.**

And yes, I used ChatGPT to write the detailed description of this post because I wanted it to sound a little more polishedXD
